name: Minecraft: Bedrock Edition (PC)

steps: Run Bedrock Dedicated Server (it listens on UDP 19132), or open your world to LAN players in game settings.
Click Start sharing and send the invite code to your friends.
Open Minecraft → Play → Servers → Add Server.

notes: Works for PC players. Older Windows (UWP) builds may block connections to your own machine; if joining fails, update Minecraft. Consoles can't use TailLAN.
